slides.title: Food truck owners: 3 questions, no Googling
slides.body: Keep score. Answers on each slide.

slides.title: 1. Parking in a new city this weekend. Does your home-city permit cover you?
slides.body: Not necessarily. Permits are often city- or county-specific. Check before you park.

slides.title: 2. Holiday hires start Friday. Who needs a food handler card?
slides.body: Check every single one. Many areas require one for anyone handling food, seasonal staff included.

slides.title: 3. Fire suppression inspection coming up. Who's tracking the date?
slides.body: You. Inspectors check it. Remembering the date is on you. What did you score?
